svg.aria-label: Animated race on the car91 problem: hill climbing stops improving after 2 s at 5.481; simulated annealing explores first and overtakes at 58 s, ending at 4.469, 5.4% above the best ever published (4.238).
svg.title: Convergence on car91
svg.text: Two minutes on one real problem: hill climbing stalls, annealing overtakes
car91, Carleton University: 682 exams, 16,925 students, 35 periods. Best penalty found so far, 5 annealing runs and 1 hill-climbing run, 120 s each.
annealing, same start as hill climbing

g.text: it accepts worse timetables on purpose to explore,
so its best so far waits; hill climbing has nowhere to go
hill climbing stops improving after 2 s
annealing cools down and overtakes at 58 s
